source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Significance Level' under topic 7.3 (PDF 97, printed 93).

blocks.text: Significance level ghalti ka khatra (risk of error) dikhata hai. Ise alpha (α) likhte hain. Aam qeemat 0.05 hai. Yeh batata hai ke test kitna sakht (strict) hai: kam qeemat ka matlab zyada sakht test. Yeh analysis se pehle chuna jata hai. Significance level ghalat nataij ko control karta aur faisle par asar dalta hai. Sahi chunao se nataij zyada qabil-e-bharosa hote hain.
